rules.rule: Keep all six designer areas and the original designer scope for each selected order and round.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 §13 R2, §17.1 and Appendix E DOC01 and DOC06.
rules.initialization: The current order and round reuse the existing workspace identity, record directory and original designer editing. Old task routes still use their native panel.
rules.dateAndPermission: Only the assigned designer and applicable task kind yield a designer action. Another role stays a waiting fact under the original display rules.
rules.expectation: Signed users see the six areas, current-versus-historical behavior, original case permissions, editable original round and exact return without access expanding to unrelated people.

rules.rule: Record the four actual handover categories with the correct version and recipient.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 §4.5A, §13 R2 and Appendix E DOC09, DOC12.
rules.initialization: Reuse the original development source, readiness record, publication/confirmation facts and quote or quantity version. Missing receipts retain their actual incomplete state.
rules.dateAndPermission: The original command and holder decide eligible recipients and permissions. Existing tasks, original clock and existing record metadata stay attached to the scope and version from capture.
rules.expectation: Exercise original material and sample receipts, a recipient change, exact quantities and confirmed quote handover, replay, access limits, retained originals and unchanged original clock state.

rules.rule: Read only exact authorized case and version IDs through the existing original forms and return to the same selection.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E §E.1 and DOC01, DOC07, DOC09–12.
rules.initialization: Use the prior saved order or source ID, selected development round, published document version and the original authorized endpoints. A directory with missing source evidence does not infer a document.
rules.dateAndPermission: Object and destination validation precede read under the existing actor and return scope. History remains read-only. Invalid page input never issues a request.
rules.expectation: Signed browser opens earlier saved fields and attachments, preserves original round and scroll/selection, validates strict paging, reads 21 explicit miscellaneous records across two pages, and keeps the exact PLT and sizes in the same authorized snapshot without duplicate requests across categories. Checked responses must pass source/version validation before reuse and can be retried after transport or response errors.

rules.rule: Preserve the exact adopted technical artifact, its original content, and the original feedback.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E DOC02–06 and DOC14.
rules.initialization: Read the existing artifact and template reference, saved task, and comment/decision ID from the original linked round. If the originally adopted version is absent, report it without inventing history.
rules.dateAndPermission: Technical, task and original attachment scopes remain distinct. A real saved original and its event or occurrence fields carry their own meanings.
rules.expectation: Exercise the saved PLT, original PDF, original material quantity, technically adopted prior round after a new revision, and exact comment and final follow-up paths without selecting the latest surrogate.

rules.rule: Use the original prep, factory, cutting and receiving facts identified by their actual record and batch.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E DOC13, DOC17–22, and §13 R2.
rules.initialization: Use existing technical scope, genuine warehouse movements, cutting record/version, production decision, QC, receipt batch and washing scope/event IDs.
rules.dateAndPermission: No factory, PO or app role makes an ungranted original visible. Preserve the actual and entry timestamps, avoid treating unrecorded time or a batch link as completion, and avoid all original writes.
rules.expectation: Signed original display verifies first/corrected cut and receipt, images, QC versions, actual preshrink completion and original history, both washing modes, warehouse issues and correctly scoped returns. Receiving and packing share the same authorized request across technical category changes, while retry, manual refresh, another order and another identity use their own authorized reads.

rules.rule: Link exact sourcing, finance and rework originals within the existing authorization.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E DOC15–16 and DOC23, DOC25.
rules.initialization: The production mother order must explicitly reference the authorized sourcing case or exact rework; the selected node and its saved version provide source identity.
rules.dateAndPermission: Existing roles and attachments determine fields and evidence. Separate contract PDF version, signed attachments, factory transfer and financial reconciliation facts.
rules.expectation: Verify original old contract PDF bytes, exact older signed record, case/node and wrong ID rejection, real finance role and two reconciliation versions, outsider denial and return to the same sourcing directory.

rules.rule: Read the retained auxiliary version without exposing the catalog or rewriting old material snapshots.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E DOC26.
rules.initialization: An existing material line has the saved catalog ID and version. The request uses the originally authorized version list and a bounded exact-version filter.
rules.dateAndPermission: Original five identities and object visibility are preserved. A new version or renamed auxiliary cannot update an already saved source snapshot.
rules.expectation: Use browser and PG to verify exact immutable version, caller scope, no fallback, previous name lookup and existing merge, retry, disable and draft-priority behavior. Reopening the same retained adopted version uses one exact request within the authorized workbench; the standalone catalog keeps its original reader.

rules.rule: Link the original approved time request without recalculating the order from the directory.
rules.source: Approved designer workbench v10.1 Appendix E DOC27 and §13 R2.
rules.initialization: List genuine authorized applications for the same source, then request the exact original request and version from the pre-existing service.
rules.dateAndPermission: PMC stays read-only, scope is tied to the actual source and authorized order. Dates and existing receipt do not move because a directory requests the original.
rules.expectation: Confirm paired original history and selected entry, correct pagination and a rejected invented version, no settlement or timing change, and old request product behaviors.
